import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Load data
crime_df = pd.read_csv("chunks_csv/getisord/getisord_crime_first_half_2013.csv", index_col="borough")
adj_df = pd.read_csv("chunks_csv/borough_adjacency.csv", usecols=["borough", "neighbor"])

# Drop boroughs with missing crime rate
crime_df = crime_df.dropna(subset=["crime_rate_value"])
data_points_used = len(crime_df)

# Build symmetric adjacency dict for boroughs with data
neighbors = {b: set() for b in crime_df.index}
for _, row in adj_df.iterrows():
    i, j = row["borough"], row["neighbor"]
    if i in neighbors and j in neighbors:
        neighbors[i].add(j)
        neighbors[j].add(i)

# Global statistics
n = data_points_used
x = crime_df["crime_rate_value"]
global_mean = x.mean()
S2 = x.var(ddof=1)

# Compute Getis-Ord Gi* for each borough
results = []
threshold = 1.96  # 95% confidence
for b in crime_df.index:
    xi = crime_df.at[b, "crime_rate_value"]
    neighs = neighbors[b]
    N_i = len(neighs) + 1  # include self
    # local sum
    if neighs:
        S_i = xi + crime_df.loc[list(neighs), "crime_rate_value"].sum()
    else:
        S_i = xi
    # expectation and variance
    E_i = N_i * global_mean
    Var_i = S2 * (N_i * (n - N_i) / (n - 1))
    if Var_i > 0:
        Gi = (S_i - E_i) / np.sqrt(Var_i)
        if abs(Gi) > threshold:
            label = "HOT" if Gi > 0 else "COLD"
            results.append(f"{b} ({label}, Gi*={Gi:.4f})")

# Output
print(f"data_points_used = {data_points_used}")
if results:
    print(f"FINAL ANSWER: {', '.join(results)}")
else:
    print("FINAL ANSWER: none")
